content_sections.heading: About SOTTO Karnataka (Jeevasarthakathe)
content_sections.text: The State Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation, Karnataka, known as SOTTO – Jeevasarthakathe, works under the Department of Health and Family Welfare Services of the Government of Karnataka. Its office is on the 6th Floor, East Wing, Arogya Soudha, 1st Cross, Magadi Road, Bengaluru – 560023. The notice is signed by the Deputy Director (e-Health) & Programme Officer, SOTTO (Jeevasarthakathe), Bengaluru, and is published in English and Kannada.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant application is submitted as a hard copy, along with the enclosures listed in the notice, either in person or by post. The notice does not print an application form or say that one is available. Prepare the hard copy application and attach every enclosure listed under "Enclosures" below. Place the application in a sealed envelope. Write on the envelope: "Application for the Post of IT Consultant – SOTTO". Address it to: Deputy Director (e-Health) & Programme Officer, SOTTO (Jeevasarthakathe), 6th Floor, East Wing, Arogya Soudha, 1st Cross, Magadi Road, Bengaluru – 560023. Hand it in at that office in person or send it by post so that it reaches by 13 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date, or incomplete applications, will not be considered. The deadline is for receipt at the office, not for dispatch.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc in Computer Science / Information Technology / Data Science / Statistics / Electronics, OR MCA/M.Sc in Computer Science / Information Technology / Data Science, from a recognised university. Preference will be given to candidates who have completed full-time regular courses. Minimum 02 years of post-qualification experience in web development, data analysis, IT consulting or AI-based application development, including preparation of reports. A portfolio of at least 02 working solutions (e.g., dashboard, website, automation tool, analytical report) developed using Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Certification in Artificial Intelligence. Working knowledge of the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994 (THOTA) and the Rules thereunder. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing and speaking Kannada and English. The upper age limit is 45 years, counted as on the last date. The SSLC marks card is the proof of date of birth. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The IT Consultant gets a consolidated pay of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The post is filled on a purely temporary and contractual basis up to 31.03.2027, and the contract may be renewed based on performance and requirement. The engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right to regular appointment or regularisation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One set of self-attested photocopies of: SSLC marks card (as proof of date of birth) Degree certificate(s) and marks cards Experience certificate(s) Aadhaar card and PAN card Along with: Two copies of an updated CV Two recent passport-size photographs Portfolio details (description with links/screenshots of the working solutions)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant post will be based on merit, relevant experience and performance in the interview. The interview will include a demonstration of the portfolio. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview, and only selected candidates will be communicated thereafter; all others shall be treated as not selected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SOTTO Karnataka Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy, for the post of IT Consultant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 13 November 2026, 5:00 PM; late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SOTTO IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc in Computer Science / Information Technology / Data Science / Statistics / Electronics, OR MCA/M.Sc in Computer Science / Information Technology / Data Science, from a recognised university, plus a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: Submit a hard copy application with the enclosures, in person or by post, in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for the Post of IT Consultant – SOTTO" to the Deputy Director (e-Health) & Programme Officer, SOTTO (Jeevasarthakathe), 6th Floor, East Wing, Arogya Soudha, 1st Cross, Magadi Road, Bengaluru – 560023.

faq.question: Q7. How will the SOTTO IT Consultant be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit, relevant experience and performance in an interview that includes a demonstration of the portfolio; only shortlisted candidates are called.

faq.question: Q8. What portfolio is required for the SOTTO IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: A portfolio of at least 02 working solutions, such as a dashboard, website, automation tool or analytical report, developed using Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Is the SOTTO Karnataka IT Consultant a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual up to 31.03.2027, may be renewed based on performance and requirement, and confers no right to regular appointment or regularisation.

faq.question: Q10. Is knowledge of Kannada required for the SOTTO IT Consultant post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be proficient in reading, writing and speaking both Kannada and English.
